name: claude-design
title_zh: 把设计想法直接变成可交互的 HTML 成品
tagline_zh: 从落地页到幻灯片、动效视频到线框图，一句话描述就能生成高保真原型。不用再开 Figma 或切图。
tagline_en: From landing pages to slide decks, animated videos to wireframes — turn a sentence into a high-fidelity HTML.
desc_en: Produce thoughtful, high-fidelity design artifacts in HTML — landing pages, slide decks, interactive prototypes, animated videos, posters, wireframes, and visual explorations. Use whenever the user asks to design, mock up, prototype, visualize, storyboard, or explore UI options — including phrases like "make a deck", "design a landing page", "prototype this flow", "animate this concept", "build a
why_zh: 它不是生成静态图片，而是产出结构完整的 HTML/CSS/JS 文件，能直接打开、交互、继续改。
why_en: It doesn't render a picture — it emits real, runnable HTML/CSS/JS. The gap between design intent and working artifact is zero.
limit_zh: 只认 HTML 输出域，不碰 React/Vue 工程或设计系统代码；产物是单文件原型，不含后端、路由或状态管理。
limit_en: HTML-only output; no React/Vue codebases or design-system engineering. Artifacts are single-file prototypes — no backend, routing, or state.
